title: DeepSeek ka open-source Super-agent - team ke liye kaam karne wala coding agent
content:
DeepSeek ne ek aisa coding agent open-source kiya hai
jo aapke prompt ka wait nahi karta.
It watches your GitHub repo and picks up work when your team asks.

Iska naam hai dsh-superagent.
DeepSeek ki Harness team ne ise 31 October 2026 ko GitHub pe daala.
License hai MIT, matlab free mein use kar sakte ho.
Aur end mein bataunga ki ye aapke liye kyun matter karta hai,
even if you never use DeepSeek.

Pehle samjho ye karta kya hai.
Normal coding agent, jaise Claude Code ya Codex,
tab kaam karta hai jab AAP usse bolte ho.
Ye agent ek GitHub repository ko sunta rehta hai.
Optionally, ye Feishu chat bhi sun sakta hai.
Jab koi ALLOWED person isse kaam maangta hai,
ye ek work item kholta hai,
apne alag session aur alag folder mein kaam karta hai,
aur wahin reply karta hai.
For example, a pull request.

Aur ek web panel hai
jo dikhata hai ki kahan pe insaan ki zaroorat hai.

Ab sabse interesting part.
Iska philosophy.
DeepSeek ke words mein:
take as little human attention as possible,
and give as much value as possible.

Matlab agent tabhi act karega jab usse maanga jaye,
ya jab team ka likha hua rule allow kare.
Aur tabhi bolega jab kisi ko action lena ho.
That is a very mature way to design an agent.

Ab ise use kaise karein?
Setup thoda lamba hai.
To DeepSeek khud kehta hai,
apne coding agent ko bolo:
read SETUP.md in this repository and set up dsh-superagent with me.
Agent aapse ek ek sawaal poochega aur setup karega.

Lekin ek warning.
DeepSeek ne clearly likha hai
ki ye research prototype hai, official product nahi.
Isme bugs ho sakte hain.
So try it on a TEST repo, not your company's main codebase.

Maan lo aapki 4 logon ki dev team hai.
Roz chhote chhote bug reports aate hain.
Aisa agent un tickets ko pehle se uthakar
draft pull request bana sakta hai,
aur aapki team sirf review karegi.

Mera take simple hai.
Agents ka future chat window nahi hai.
Future hai agents jo team ke workflow mein baith ke kaam karein,
with clear rules on when they can act.
Ye design samajh liya,
toh aap kisi bhi company ke liye agents bana sakte ho.

Comment SUPERAGENT and I'll DM you the link.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
